# Japan Highlights

> > Comprehensive travel guides and curated tours for exploring Japan's iconic destinations, seasonal experiences, and cultural highlights.

Japan Highlights provides expert travel planning resources covering major destinations like Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and Hokkaido, with specialized guides for seasonal travel including cherry blossom viewing, fall foliage, and winter sports. The site offers both self-guided itineraries and organized family tours operated by Highlights Travel, founded by Victor Shu with 25+ years of experience.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo
- Kyoto
- Osaka
- Mount Fuji
- Shinkansen bullet train
- Cherry blossom season (hanami)
- Fall foliage
- Hokkaido
- Hot springs (onsen)
- Travel planning
- Winter sports and skiing
- Japan Rail Pass
- Seasonal weather guides
- Cultural experiences
- Family travel

## Essential Travel Planning

- [1-Week in Japan: How to Plan a Perfect Itinerary (2026)](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/1-week-itinerary): 7-day Japan itinerary: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka highlights for first-time visit
- [Japan Shinkansen Guide: How to Ride It for an Easy Trip](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/shinkansen): Complete Shinkansen bullet train guide: tickets, seats, routes, travel tips
- [The 3 Best Ways to Travel from Narita Airport to Tokyo](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/tokyo/travel-from-narita-airport-to-tokyo): Narita Airport to Tokyo guide: Skyliner, Narita Express, buses, costs/times
- [Gluten-Free Food in Japan - Does Japan Have Gluten Free Food?](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/gluten-free-food): Gluten-free dining in Japan: safe foods, rice dishes, Tokyo restaurants

## Seasonal Travel Guides

- [Japan Weather in April 2026: Cherry Blossom Peak & Travel Tips](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/weather-in-april): April weather guide featuring cherry blossom season in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka
- [Japan Fall Foliage 2026: How to Plan the Perfect Autumn Trip](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/plan-fall-foliage-trip): 2026 fall foliage guide: timing, best spots in Hokkaido, Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka
- [Plan a Japan Summer Trip 2026: Itineraries & Best Places](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/planning-a-summer-trip): Summer Japan guide: festivals, Mt. Fuji hiking, itineraries, visa info
- [Japan Weather in January 2026: Tips for Enjoying Japan in the Coldest Month](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/weather-in-january): January weather guide for Japan: temps from Sapporo to Okinawa, skiing tips
- [Hokkaido Weather in January 2026: A Winter Wonderland at Its Peak](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/hokkaido/weather-in-january): Hokkaido January weather: skiing, snow festivals, Sapporo, hot springs

## Cherry Blossom Experiences

- [Mt Fuji Cherry Blossom 2026 - When, Where and Tips for a Better Trip](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/plan-a-cherry-blossom-trip/mt-fuji): Mt. Fuji cherry blossoms: Chureito Pagoda, Lake Kawaguchiko, mid-April peak
- [The Meguro River Illuminations - Nakameguro Cherry Blossom Festival](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/plan-a-cherry-blossom-trip/meguro-river): Meguro River cherry blossom festival guide: Nakameguro illuminations, Tokyo

## Cultural Experiences & Events

- [Sumo Wrestling in Japan 2026: When, Where and How to Experience](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/sumo-wrestling): Sumo wrestling guide: 2026 tournament schedule, tickets, Tokyo/Osaka venues
- [Top 12 Japan Fireworks Festivals in 2026: Hanabi Schedual and Dates](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/top-hanabi-festivals): 2026 hanabi festivals: schedules, viewing spots, Lake Kawaguchi, Tokyo events

## Destination Guides

- [Is Fukuoka Worth Visiting? 8 Firsthand Reasons After Exploring](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/fukuoka): Fukuoka travel guide: Kyushu gateway, tonkotsu ramen, day trips to Nagasaki
- [Where to Stay in Hakone: Best 4 Areas & Hotels, Travel Tips](https://www.japanhighlights.com/japan/hakone/where-to-stay): Hakone accommodation guide: best areas Hakone-Yumoto, Gora, ryokan onsen
